title: Install pytest into the shared .venv
why: Needed for tests across challenges; pure-Python, no torch or numpy changes

result: src/metrics.py: summarize(group_by,start,end,where), floor_daily, machine_days, manager_bottom10. Ratio of sums, off-floor rows excluded. luck_z = (house_win-theo)/sqrt(sum_bet_squared*payout_multiplier_variance); daily z mean -0.01 SD 1.04, so calibrated. 7 tests pass (floor totals match property_day exactly on all 181 days). Lead: M-1158 hold 3.0% vs 10% theo, z=-4.6, only |z|>3 machine of 310.
